description:
A top Greenland mining official said President Donald Trump’s claims that “massive” oil, gas and mineral exploration will soon begin in Greenland are heavily exaggerated, citing well-known barriers to beginning such a project, marking the latest dispute between Trump and Greenland as he’s repeatedly said the Danish territory should become part of the U.S.

description:
How do you take a digitally native darling and scale it into a global, omnichannel powerhouse? In this episode of C-Suite Unscripted, host Maggie McGrath sits down with Dayna Quanbeck, CEO of Rothy’s. Dayna pulls back the curtain on the brand’s massive growth, their cutting-edge manufacturing process (including a shoe made entirely without glue), and why the future of retail is a balance of clicks and bricks.
